data.one_liner: A Flutter/Dart library to control WhatsApp Web via Puppeteer for sending messages and handling events.
data.what_it_does: It connects to WhatsApp Web using a headless Chromium instance and provides a client API to send texts, files, and other media. It also streams connection and chat events for reactive handling.
use_when: You need to automate WhatsApp messaging from a Flutter or Dart app
You want to integrate WhatsApp interactions without using official APIs
You are building desktop or web automation tools that require WhatsApp access
avoid_when: Official, supported WhatsApp integration is required
You need a solution that works on iOS/Android without extra setup
You cannot tolerate potential account bans from unofficial clients
strengths: Supports desktop, web and mobile via separate package
Rich set of WhatsApp features (media, contacts, groups)
weaknesses: Relies on web scraping; may break with WhatsApp updates
Requires Chromium download or external browserless service
Not officially supported by WhatsApp, risk of bans
data.setup_notes: Desktop: first run downloads Chromium; Mobile: add flutter_inappwebview and follow its setup; Web: use whatsapp_bot_flutter_web or provide a browserless endpoint.
